examples.text: tena kho pana samayena rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto vajjī abhiyātu'kāmo hoti. so evam'āha, ahaṃ h'ime vajjī evaṃmah'iddhike evaṃmah'ānubhāve ucchejjāmi vajjī, vināsessāmi vajjī, anayabyasanaṃ āpādessāmi vajjī'ti.
ucchedaṃ vadāmi rāgassa dosassa mohassa
sato vā pana sattassa ucchedaṃ vināsaṃ vibhavaṃ paññapenti, diṭṭhadhammanibbānaṃ vā pan'eke abhivadanti.
ṭhān'āṭhāne na saṇṭhātī'ti kāraṇ'ākāraṇe na saṇṭhāti. tatr'āyaṃ nayo, sassatavādī yuttena kāraṇena pahoti ucchedavādiṃ niggahetuṃ, ucchedavādī tena niggayhamāno, kiṃ pan'āhaṃ ucchedaṃ vadāmī'ti

14386.meaning1: doctrine of annihilation at death; doctrine of materialism

examples.text: api ca kho evaṃdiṭṭhi hoti, no c'assaṃ no ca me siyā n'ābhavissaṃ na me bhavissatī'ti. yā kho pana sā, bhikkhave, ucchedadiṭṭhi saṅkhāro so. so pana saṅkhāro kiṃnidāno kiṃsamudayo kiṃjātiko kiṃpabhavo?

14387.meaning1: (proponent of the) doctrine of annihilation; annihilationist view
14387.commentary: (ANa) puna brāhmaṇo tadeva abhivādan'ādikammaṃ bhagavati apassanto imaṃ āgamma ayaṃ lokatanti lokapaveṇī ucchijjatī'ti maññamāno bhagavantaṃ ucchedavādo'ti āha. bhagavā pana yasmā pañcakāmaguṇikarāgassa c'eva akusalacitta-dvaya-sampayuttassa ca dosassa anāgāmimaggena ucchedaṃ vadati, sabb'ākusalasambhavassa pana mohassa arahattamaggena ucchedaṃ vadati, ṭhapetvā te tayo avasesānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ yath'ānurūpaṃ catūhi maggehi ucchedaṃ vadati, tasmā taṃ ucchedavādaṃ attani sampassamāno aparaṃ pariyāyam'anujāni.

examples.text: ucchedavādo bhavaṃ gotamo'ti

14388.meaning1: annihilationist; proponent of the doctrine of annihilation
14388.meaning2: who professes the doctrine of annihilation
14388.commentary: (NPa) ime vuccanti ucchedavādino'ti ime rūp'ādike pañcakkhandhe attato upagacchantā rūp'ādīnaṃ aniccabhāvato ucchijjati attā vinassati na hoti paraṃ maraṇā'ti evaṃ abhinivisanato ucchedavādino'ti vuccanti. (NPt) ime diṭṭhicaritā puggalā rūp'ādayo ca attā, rūp'ādīnañ'ca aniccattā, attassā'pi aniccattā attā ucchijjati, attā vinassati, attā paraṃ maraṇā na hotī'ti abhinivisanato ucchedavādino'ti vuccanti.

examples.text: ṭhān'āṭhāne na saṇṭhātī'ti kāraṇ'ākāraṇe na saṇṭhāti. tatr'āyaṃ nayo, sassatavādī yuttena kāraṇena pahoti ucchedavādiṃ niggahetuṃ, ucchedavādī tena niggayhamāno, kiṃ pan'āhaṃ ucchedaṃ vadāmī'ti

14390.meaning2: connected with throwing away; involving what is thrown away

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, yato kho bhikkhuno chasu phass'āyatanesu cittaṃ udujitaṃ hoti sudujitaṃ, ajjhattam'eva santiṭṭhati, sannisīdati, ekodi hoti, samādhiyati.

14392.synonym: avaṅka, ujuka, ujugata, ujubhūta, ujjugata, ujjubhūta, tujjubhūta, sūju

examples.text: so pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā, ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā
pañc'ime, bhikkhave, ānisaṃsā dhammassavane. katame pañca? assutaṃ suṇāti, sutaṃ pariyodāpeti, kaṅkhaṃ vitarati, diṭṭhiṃ ujuṃ karoti, cittam'assa pasīdati.

14393.commentary: (DNa) ujuvipaccanīkavādā'ti īsakam'pi apariharitvā ujum'eva vividhapaccanīkavādā, anekavāraṃ viruddhavādā eva hutvā'ti attho.

examples.text: tesaṃ'y'eva kho, gahapatayo, samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā ujuvipaccanīkavādā. te evam'āhaṃsu, atthi dinnaṃ, atthi yiṭṭhaṃ, atthi hutaṃ

14394.synonym: akukkuka, avaṅka, uju, ujugata, ujubhūta, ujjugata, ujjubhūta, tujjubhūta, sūju
14394.commentary: (SNa) cittam'attano ujukaṃ akaṃsū'ti attano citte sabbe vaṅka-kuṭila-jimha-bhāve haritvā ujukaṃ akariṃsu.

examples.text: tatra bhikkhavo samādahaṃsu, cittam'attano ujukaṃ akaṃsu, sārathī'va nettāni gahetvā, indriyāni rakkhanti paṇḍitā'ti.
ujuko nāma so maggo, abhayā nāma sā disā, ratho akūjano nāma, dhammacakkehi saṃyuto.
ambho, rukkha, pubbe tvaṃ olambakaṃ otārento viya ujukam'eva phalāni pātesi

14398.commentary: (DNa) cittam'attano ujukaṃ akaṃsū'ti attano cittaṃ sabbe vaṅka-kuṭila-jimha-bhāve haritvā ujukaṃ akariṃsu.

examples.text: tatra bhikkhavo samādahaṃsu, cittam'attano ujukam'akaṃsu, sārathī'va nettāni gahetvā, indriyāni rakkhanti paṇḍitā'ti.

14399.synonym: avaṅka, uju, ujuka, ujubhūta, ujjubhūta, tujjubhūta, sūju

examples.text: yaṃ kiñci yiṭṭhaṃ va hutaṃ va loke, saṃvaccharaṃ yajetha puññapekkho, sabbam'pi taṃ na catubhāgam'eti, abhivādanā ujugatesu seyyo.
ujugatam'ev'assa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti sīlaṃ ārabbha.
